title.narrative: Strengthening Utilities and Promoting Energy Reform (SUPER)

description.narrative: SUPER works hand in hand with utilities and other energy sector entities to increase electricity access, decrease technical and commercial losses, strengthen human capital and operational practices, plan system expansion, explore new models for private sector engagement, incorporate climate change mitigation, and integrate new technologies.
